title: Enforce planning-gate decision coverage
summary: Make planning gate return remediation when approved decision rows/questions lack coverage or existing-roadmap reconciliation evidence.

goal.outcome: Planning validation fails with actionable remediation when decision rows/questions or roadmap reconciliation are incomplete, and passes when coverage evidence is complete.
acceptance: Planning gate inspects approved decision rows, requirements, and downstream planning questions from decision builds/traces.
Planning gate verifies each item maps to task, sprint, deferral, no-work rationale, or implementation evidence.
Planning gate verifies planning builds include existing-roadmap reconciliation evidence.
Fail/block reports route to planning-loop remediation and do not imply user-stop when remediation is actionable.
Tests cover missing row coverage, missing roadmap reconciliation, and passing complete coverage.
non_goals: Do not implement source-root migration in this task.
Do not require global zero lint warnings.
Do not break legacy decision/planning build compatibility.
verification: targeted TASK test for planning-gate coverage

delta.desired:
Additional outcome: Trace/graph views expose decision coverage and roadmap reconciliation states for implemented, deferred, superseded, unmapped, and replanned work.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Decision loop source ownership uses `src/decision/**` for decision tables/compiler/tool/gate responsibilities while preserving public API behavior.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Planning loop source ownership uses `src/planning/**` for work shaping, roadmap mutation, and planning tool responsibilities while preserving roadmap behavior.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Implementation loop build/compiler ownership uses `src/implementation/**` while preserving build artifact compatibility and trace handoff behavior.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Generated graph/read-model ownership uses `src/graph/**` and `src/state/**` is retired or reduced to documented compatibility only.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Pi commands/tools/prompt/assets/compaction ownership uses `src/pi/**` while preserving package and prompt contract behavior.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Runtime/session/workflow/retention responsibilities move to target runtime, git, and telemetry ownership while preserving runtime coordination behavior.
